chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha', from Musanna, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, the people are of three levels: a level who are from us and we are from them; and a level who adorn themselves with us; and a level who consume one another with us.

key_terms.يَتَزَيَّنُونَ بِنَا: adorn themselves with us (using our name for status)

ai.seo_question: What are the three levels of people according to Imam al-Sadiq (AS) in relation to the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) delineates the spiritual stratification of humanity relative to the Ahl al-Bayt, a concept central to Shia sociological thought. The first tier represents the true adherents whose identity is inseparable from the Imams; the second comprises the Murji'ah or superficial adherents who utilize the Ahl al-Bayt for social prestige; and the third denotes the exploiters who consume one another through the lens of the Imams' authority. This classification underscores the distinction between genuine spiritual lineage and performative or utilitarian religiosity.

en.hubeali: H 14723 – Al-Husayn Bin Muhammad Al-Ashary, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Al-Washaa, from Musanna, from Abu Baseer, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws has said that:

‘The people are of three levels – A level who are from us<sup>asws</sup> and we<sup>asws</sup> are from them; and a level who adorn themselves by us<sup>asws</sup> (our<sup>asws</sup> name); and a level who eat each other by us<sup>asws</sup> (our<sup>asws</sup> name)’.
en.sarwar: 275. Al-Husayn Bin Muhammad Al-Ashary, from Mu‘alla Bin Muhammad, from Al-Hassan Bin Ali Al-Washaa, from Musanna, from Abu Baseer, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said that:

‘The people are of three levels – A level who are from us (a.s.) and we (a.s.) are from them; and a level who adorn themselves by us (a.s.) (our (a.s.) name); and a level who eat each other by us (a.s.) (our (a.s.) name)’.
